method: Deterministic source-family batch manifest generated from the full certification ledger. Batches organize review work; they do not certify records by themselves.
public_claim_limit: Batch membership is a review workflow label. It must not be described as external validation, endorsement, ranking, prevalence measurement, safety scoring, severity scoring, or legal finding.
completion_rule: A batch is complete only when every included record has a final visible status: certified, not_certified, blocked, or awaiting_review with exact open gates. Zero certifications is acceptable when sources do not support certification.

blocked_or_problem.label: Blocked/problem records
blocked_or_problem.completion_rule: Every record must retain a final visible status with exact blocker or not-certified reason before reconsideration.

ed_dataset.label: ED dataset records
ed_dataset.completion_rule: Every record must have a final visible status and exact gates; source-cell provenance is required before certification.

asr.label: Annual security report records
asr.completion_rule: Every record must have page, table, section, or item locator review before certification.

ocr_or_government_release.label: OCR or government release records
ocr_or_government_release.completion_rule: Every record must have item-level or document-section support and bounded legal/procedural wording.

university_statement.label: University statement records
university_statement.completion_rule: Every record must preserve direct statement boundaries, response-depth classification, and source-supported labels.

public_notice_or_news.label: Public notice or news-like records
public_notice_or_news.completion_rule: Every record must separate reported allegations, public notice wording, and direct institutional response.

other_public_source.label: Other public-source records
other_public_source.completion_rule: Every record must retain exact open gates and a final visible status before the batch is complete.
